cookbooks.title: Getting Started with Dynamo + Valkey
cookbooks.lead: Deploy NVIDIA Dynamo with Valkey as the distributed KV cache backend via LMCache, enabling sub-millisecond cache lookups for multi-worker inference.

cookbooks.title: KV-Aware Routing with Valkey
cookbooks.lead: Leverage Dynamo's KV router to direct requests toward workers with warm Valkey-backed caches, minimizing redundant prefill across the cluster.

cookbooks.title: Production Deployment on AWS
cookbooks.lead: Deploy Dynamo + Valkey on EKS with ElastiCache Serverless, TLS, disaggregated serving, and observability.
